categories.definition: Coverage of corporate financial results, mergers and acquisitions, economic indicators, trade, markets, and regulatory actions affecting commerce.

categories.name: Sport
categories.definition: News concerning competitive athletic events, match results, team management, and athlete performances across various disciplines.

categories.name: Technology
categories.definition: Articles detailing product launches, software and hardware developments, internet trends, and legal issues within the technology sector.

categories.name: Entertainment and Arts

categories.name: Science and Health
